_comment: Labeled questionnaire snippets for the Epic B framework detector (P.4.2.1). expected_framework = cdp|ecovadis|walmart|tesco_cdf|generic. confident=true means the detector should be confident (not low-confidence); ambiguous cases set confident=false and must NOT be confidently mislabeled (return generic or low-confidence). Used by evals/test_framework_detection.py to measure accuracy + the safety property BEFORE any UI (mirrors A3).
